name: Found wood and scrape
desc: Dry found-object groove from wooden and scraped bodies: clave and slitdrum interlock in polymeter, guiro scrapes, cabasa ghost shuffle, call-response masking and a slow lpf drift. Clicky, organic, ritual.

code.full: stack(s("clave(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(${gain}*.9), s("{woodblock slitdrum cajon}%5").gain(${gain}*.7), s("guiro(1,4,<0 2>)").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.3), s("cabasa*8").gain(".3 .18 .25 .15 .3 .18 .25 .2").late("[0 .03]*4")).shape(.3).iter(4).mask("<1 1 1 0>").lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.7, ${bright}*1.4).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(12)).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("clave(5,16,<0 3 6 9>)").gain(${gain}*.9), s("{woodblock slitdrum cajon agogo}%7").gain(${gain}*.7), s("guiro(3,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${gain}*.5), s("cabasa*16").gain(".28 .15 .22 .15").late("[0 .02]*8"), s("vibraslap(1,8,<3 6>)").gain(${gain}*.45).room(.4)).shape(.32).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).iter(8).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.8, ${bright}*1.5).slow(8)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(10)).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
